questions.prompt: Which of these are planets in our solar system?
questions.fact: Europa and Titan are moons, and Ceres is a dwarf planet in the asteroid belt.

questions.prompt: Which of these instruments do you play with a bow?
questions.fact: A harp is plucked, not bowed, even though it is a string instrument like the other three.

questions.prompt: How many years did the Berlin Wall stand?
questions.fact: Twenty-eight. It went up overnight in August 1961 and came down in November 1989.

questions.prompt: How tall is the Eiffel Tower, in metres?
questions.fact: 330 metres to the tip. It was the tallest building in the world for 41 years.

questions.prompt: In which event would you see a Fosbury flop?
questions.hint: Dick Fosbury changed how one event is cleared, by going over backwards.
questions.fact: Dick Fosbury went over the bar backwards at the 1968 Olympics and won. Every high jumper does it his way now.

questions.prompt: Who composed the music for Star Wars?
questions.hint: The same composer wrote the themes for Jaws and Indiana Jones.
questions.fact: John Williams wrote it in 1977 for a full orchestra, at a time when film scores were going electronic.
